title: Balatro inspired poker puzzle game in 1 week with Cursor + ChatGPT Image gen 2
author: ProjektProgram
selftext:
Cursor for coding and chatgpt image gen 2 came out at the perfect time to help make this fun little browser game. 

I was originally going to build it out in Unity but figured I'd try it out as a web game with cursor first - It was so close to my vision the first shot I figured I'd keep going. 

And now with ChatGPT's new image gen capabilities I feel like we truly can make any asset or mock up to pass over to cursor to build. 

Very cool process which I'm happy to chat about further. Also feel free Try it out at [www.pokaria.com](http://www.pokaria.com)

comments.author: Snowpire

replies.author: ProjektProgram
replies.body: Wow that's 3x higher than me the developer, I'll have to look at the scaling lol - would love to hear your thoughts!

replies.author: Snowpire
replies.body:
It was really fun and addictive, but very imbalanced. Becoming unstoppable was just a matter of math.


For example, since the 10x bonus on Aces and deuces stack, it means that you can get insane multipliers after a while, to the point where a single ace let's you win. The same with other cards.


Stacking multipliers leads to exponential growth, so it was quite obvious after a while that the beat perks to pick would USUALLY be the ones that gave the highest multipler regardless of what it was.

replies.author: FreeEye5
replies.body: I got to 80 before I got bored. Agree with the other commenters - really fun, slick game. Trivial to break though. Infinite stacking 10x buffs meant that I was earning more than 500 trillion per hand by the end

replies.author: ProjektProgram
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback. I’m reworking the scaling now to keep the challenge there late game.
